causes.reasoning: Leaf service called by travel/travel2/basic shows JVM init failure, CPU spike to 49.7, mem surge and p95 latency 5ms->12.7ms; callers fail with 503 calling it.
Direct caller of route-service shows 0->0.076 error with 24x 503 Service Unavailable logs when calling downstream, victim of route failure.
Second caller of route-service shows same 503 Service Unavailable pattern and 0->0.026 error, parallel victim.
Aggregates travel/travel2 and shows 19x Internal Server Error with 0->0.063 error, downstream victim of travel failures.
Socket count 6->2 with connection-ended/accepted logs coincident with route restart, reflects route closing/reopening DB connections rather than DB failure.
